BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE course ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE module ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE section ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE task_test ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_key varchar(255);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS course_source_key_unique_idx
    ON course (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS module_source_key_unique_idx
    ON module (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS section_source_key_unique_idx
    ON section (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_source_key_unique_idx
    ON lesson (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_source_key_unique_idx
    ON task (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_source_key_unique_idx
    ON task_test (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS task_test_variant_source_key_unique_idx
    ON task_test_variant (source_key)
    WHERE source_key IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
